text:
Asha (engineering lead): Thanks everyone for joining the all-hands today. Quick follow-up thread for the reliability incident RCA and the action items we promised to publish. RCA link: https://redwood.internal/rcas/2026-03-21-cache-ttl-regen (internal) :link:
Ben (SRE): saw the doc, thanks Asha. can we get the actual rollout plan for the TTL change? not clear who is pacing the canary.
Asha (engineering lead): good call — plan is in the RCA under "Mitigation & Rollout". short summary: canary 10% traffic -> 50% -> 100% with 1h observation windows, automated rollback on error-rate > 1.5%. owner: Ben.
Ben (SRE): got it. i'll take ownership of the canary and rollback hooks. i'll add the runbook snippet to eng-sre playbooks.
Carla (product): for product teams — do we have a customer-facing status blurb prepared? eli can you coordinate?
Eli (customer-succ): i can draft a short message. need impact window and affected orgs list. where's the customer impact in the RCA?
Asha (engineering lead): customer impact section is under "Impact & Timeline" in the RCA. summary: ~45 minutes elevated latency for 7% of requests between 03:05–03:50 UTC affecting inference-hosted customers using dedicated routing. i'll DM deeper details to support.
Dina (eng-ml): heading to update the monitoring alerts: we should add a KV-cache-miss ratio alert and a tail-latency SLO burn rate alert. proposing thresholds in the doc: KV-miss > 4% sustained for 10m, p99 > 400ms for 5m.
Frank (platform): will wire the console dashboards for the KV-miss metric and add to the per-customer view. ETA 2d.
Ben (SRE): can we get a simple check to validate the TTL migration before memcache purge? suggestion: small canary keyset + smoke query that asserts prefixes are served from hot cache. i can script that.
Asha (engineering lead): agreed, add as pre-migration gate. Ben please add the script to the RCA repo and post the snippet here when ready.
inc-bot: deploy started by Ben to canary pool gpux-dedicated-1 (canary=10%) — build 2026.03.21-rca-fix.
Ben (SRE): deploy looks clean so far, metrics within expected range at 10%. i'll bump to 50% in 35m if stable.
Carla (product): one ask from PMs: timeline for a UI note in the Console explaining what happened (short, non-technical). Frank / Eli can pair on that?
Eli (customer-succ): yes i'll partner with Frank. frank — can you grab the 7% affected orgs export and i'll craft the note + targeted outreach?
Frank (platform): exporting list now. will push to secure drive and ping you.
Dina (eng-ml): also adding a regression test to the model-serving tests to catch TTL regressions. ETA 3d.
Asha (engineering lead): awesome. to keep this actionable i added a checklist in the RCA with owners and rough ETAs — please confirm by EOD so i can close the all-hands follow-ups. current open owners: Ben (canary + rollback script), Frank (dashboards + org export), Dina (alerts + regression test), Eli (customer comms).
Ben (SRE): confirming ownership. will post script here when done.
Frank (platform): confirming dashboards and export.
Dina (eng-ml): confirming alerts + regression test.
Eli (customer-succ): confirming comms. drafting now.
Carla (product): thanks team. can we also add a short blurb to the roadmap doc about adding more KV cache observability? small item for Optimize roadmap.
Asha (engineering lead): added to roadmap backlog. priority: P2.
Ben (SRE): one more question — do we need a post-mortem blameless review session? would like a 30m sync to review the timeline and lessons.
Asha (engineering lead): yes let's schedule a 30m blameless review next week. i'll create a calendar invite and include relevant authors.
Eli (customer-succ): once the customer note is ready i'll post it to #support and send targeted emails for the impacted orgs.
Asha (engineering lead): thanks everyone. if you claimed an owner item here but are blocked, ping me directly. closing note: RCA doc will be the single source of truth for these follow-ups.
Ben (SRE): script posted: https://redwood.internal/rca/2026-03-21/cache-gate-script.sh — please sanity-check.
Dina (eng-ml): quick nit: can we include the new KV-miss metric name in the RCA (metrics path: inference.kv_cache.miss_ratio) so dashboards pick it up consistently?
Frank (platform): will update dashboard queries to use that metrics path.
Carla (product): done-for-now. :thumbsup:
Asha (engineering lead): last call: anyone else with open questions? otherwise i'll mark actions as in-progress.
Carla (product): all good from PM side.
inc-bot: deploy to 50% started by Ben — build 2026.03.21-rca-fix.
Ben (SRE): 50% looks stable after 1h observation. proceeding to 100% in 10m. will monitor burn-rates.
Asha (engineering lead): thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround. we'll add notes to the next all-hands on lessons learned. :rocket:
